summary: L-4 cab on the ground, Lewis and Clark NF; built 1938, fireguard radio report 1940, abandoned 1963, gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab, ground level (not on a tower)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1963 and gone, per firelookout.com.

events.note: Fireguard to report by short-wave radio that season instead of by telephone; Dale Cameron installed the radio.

evidence.supports: Called a cabin, not a tower
Location: 20 miles ENE of White Sulphur Springs, Meagher County
evidence.quote: 20 miles ENE of White Sulphur Springs

evidence.supports: 1940 fireguard to report by short-wave radio instead of telephone
evidence.quote: The fireguard at Elephant Rock will report by short wave radio this season instead of telephone.
Dale Cameron installed the radio there

evidence.supports: 1940 item printed in the Montana Standard
Status listed only as removed, with no date

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the 1938 and 1963 dates come only from firelookout.com. The montanalookouts page says 'Removed' with no date, so no removal event is dated. A Reddit thread (r/firelookouts) for this site could not be read. Access is not documented, so the brief's 'unknown' stands. No source describes what remains at the site today.
